steps.run:
set +e; readlink -f /bin/sh; command -v sh; command -v timeout; printf 'timeout_lookup_rc=%s
' "$?"; test -f package.json; printf 'package_rc=%s
' "$?"; p=$(command -v pack); r=$?; printf 'pack_path=%s pack_lookup_rc=%s
' "$p" "$r"; if [ "$r" -eq 0 ]; then pack --version; printf 'pack_version_rc=%s
' "$?"; fi; exit 0
